description: This file defines API route handlers for managing parameters and their thresholds in a manufacturing equipment maintenance backend system, implemented using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing a parameter definition.

classes.name: ParameterThreshold
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing threshold settings for a parameter on specific equipment.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model used for authentication and role-based access control.

methods.name: list[ParameterOut] list_parameters( active_only: bool = Query(False, description="If true, only return active parameters"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieve a list of parameters, optionally filtering only active ones.

methods.name: ParameterOut create_parameter( payload: ParameterCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN", "ENGINEER")), )
methods.description: Create a new parameter definition, restricted to ADMIN and ENGINEER roles.

methods.name: ParameterOut update_parameter( parameter_id: int, payload: ParameterUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN", "ENGINEER")), )
methods.description: Update existing parameter details, restricted to ADMIN and ENGINEER roles.

methods.name: list[ThresholdOut] list_thresholds( equipment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieve thresholds associated with a specific equipment ID.

methods.name: ThresholdOut create_threshold( equipment_id: int, payload: ThresholdCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_roles("ADMIN", "ENGINEER")), )
methods.description: Create a new threshold for specific equipment and parameter, deactivating previous active thresholds.
